input: What did Snowflake say about consumption trends on its most recent earnings call?

output.question: What did Snowflake say about consumption trends on its most recent earnings call?
output.answer: Snowflake's most recent call is for Q2 fiscal 2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026), held September 2, 2026. Management said consumption kept speeding up. CFO Brian Robins said product revenue 'once again accelerated to reach 37% year over year growth,' helped by 'continued strength in our core data platform business and a meaningful step up in AI revenue.' CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy described AI as a 'structural multiplier': customers who use AI on Snowflake consume more across the whole data platform, and accounts using its Cortex Code ('CoCo') product also consume more of the core platform. Snowflake raised its FY27 product revenue guidance to $6.07B (+36%) from $5.84B. It guided Q3 product revenue to $1.588–1.593B (+37–38%), which Robins said is based on 'observed consumption patterns.' He also noted net revenue retention of 126%, said bookings will lean more toward Q4, and said AI workloads carry lower margins for now, so FY27 product gross margin is guided to 74%.

key_facts.fact: Q2 FY27 product revenue grew 37% year over year, a further acceleration, driven by core data platform strength and a meaningful step up in AI revenue (CFO Brian Robins).
CEO Ramaswamy: customers using AI on Snowflake consume more across the data platform, creating a 'structural multiplier'; CoCo-using accounts consume more of the core platform.
FY27 product revenue guidance raised to $6.07B (36% growth) from $5.84B; guidance is based on observed consumption patterns.
Q3 FY27 product revenue guidance is $1.588–$1.593B (37–38% growth).
Q2 product revenue was $1.49B; net revenue retention was 126%; RPO was $9B, up 30%.
Bookings are expected to be increasingly weighted toward Q4; AI workloads carry lower contribution margin today, and FY27 product gross margin is guided to 74%.

passages.quote: In Q2, product revenue once again accelerated to reach 37% year over year growth.
Customers using AI on Snowflake consume more across the data platform creating a structural multiplier.
As always, our forecast is based on observed consumption patterns.
For FY 2027, we now expect product revenue of $6.07 billion representing 36% year over year growth.
we expect bookings to be increasingly weighted towards the fourth quarter.
The Agentic Enterprise runs on Snowflake, and we're just getting started.

caveats: Snowflake's Q3 FY27 results will probably come out in late November or early December 2026, so this Q2 call is the latest one as of 2026-11-10 but will soon be replaced.

The quotes come from third-party transcripts (Motley Fool) and a news summary, not Snowflake's own IR page; the Business Wire press release returned a 403 error. The transcripts contain some garbled wording, such as 'Cocoa' for CoCo.
Management did not put a number on the AI consumption uplift, according to call summaries.
Secondary sources disagree on AI product account counts (for example, whether 9,100 accounts belongs to CoCo or CoWork) and on the non-GAAP operating margin outlook (14.5% vs 15.5%).
